# Degree or coefficient size: what each order follows (generated by order_report.py)

Kendall tau-b per target of each order against the character's degree and against 1/|yhat|; positive = higher degree (smaller coefficient) comes later; 'all tied' = one of the two has a single value (e.g. every |yhat| equal). Orders: networks' onset step (online, seed-mean learned fraction); DFG's n onset (median of 3 seeds); on |S| <= 4 also the networks' n onset (fixed-n study) and DFG's n onset restricted to the same characters.
